newsitem.title: UK: Bank of England says inflation report due May 13.
newsitem.headline: Bank of England says inflation report due May 13.

text.p: The Bank of England's next quarterly inflation report will still be published at 1030 GMT (1130 BST) on May 13, a Bank of England spokesman confirmed on Wednesday.
The bank needs a clear week from the monthly monetary meeting to prepare its analysis of the inflation prospects.
The new Labour government brought the May monetary meeting forward by one day, holding it on May 6 and enabling the central bank to stick to its publication schedule.
